article.title: RVDSA Releases Voter Guide on 2026 Massachusetts Ballot Questions
article.author: River Valley DSA
article.content: On November 3rd, voters will go to the polls and face nine ballot questions, some of which will have significant impacts on working people in Massachusetts. At the October General Meeting, RVDSA members approved the following slate of positions: Vote Yes on 1 to expand public records laws to apply to the Governor, State House, […]
